result.summary: Found 3 visual issues, including a likely incorrect active navigation state and a couple of clipping/overlap problems that make the page look unfinished.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights “Profile” as the active tab, but the visible content is the home/discovery feed with delivery address, search, categories, and restaurant lists.
issues.suggestion: Set the active bottom navigation item to “Home” when showing this screen, or navigate to the actual Profile screen when Profile is selected.

issues.description: The category chip row has a partially visible blank/gray chip at the far right edge, which looks accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontal carousel, ensure the next chip is partially visible with readable text or add proper end spacing/scroll affordance. Otherwise, prevent horizontal overflow.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrolling restaurant cards in the “Fastest near you” section are clipped at the right edge, including truncated card content.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel behavior, spacing, or snap points so partially visible cards look intentional and do not cut text awkwardly.
